newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for power and heat station.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for power and heat station.

text.p: Poland invited bids for up to 75 percent of the heat and power station Elektrocieplownia Krakow SA in blocks of no less than 10 percent, the privatisation ministry said in a newspaper advertisement on Friday.
It said the deadline for the bids was November 29.
The invitation is the second this year after the ministry cancelled the first one, issued on July 9, giving no reasons.
The ministry earmarked 20 percent of the company, based in the southern city of Krakow, for employees and five percent for a planned fund to meet claims for property confiscated under communist rule.
The Elektrocieplownia Krakow had a net profit of 26.7 million zlotys on 236.7 million turnover in 1995.
